name: np-campaign-seat
_comment: ARM 3 — 'The Seat'. Two questions only play can answer: is +1 DP worth staying home for (§8), and does HOLD actually HOLD (audit finding B4 — a sovereign on HOLD fell into the arm labelled 'else: # aggressive' and sallied out unordered; fixed, never played). Napoleon is ordered to hold Paris on turn 1 and never ordered again; every subsequent line is the marshals' war. If he moves, the fix regressed. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).
